subject: System Design
title: Google Spanner and TrueTime
description: A micro-lesson that makes Google Spanner and TrueTime usable.

hook.text: Google Spanner is the only database that provides global strong consistency with external consistency.

buildup.text: TrueTime uses GPS receivers and atomic clocks in every data center to bound clock uncertainty.

discovery.text: TrueTime returns an interval: earliest and latest possible time. Spanner waits out the uncertainty window.

twist.text: Waiting out uncertainty adds latency to every commit — typically 7ms. Google accepts this for correctness.

climax.text: Spanner proves that with precise enough clocks, global strong consistency is achievable at scale.

punchline.text: GPS and atomic clocks make global consistency possible.

quiz.question: How does Google Spanner achieve global consistency?
options: Using GPS and atomic clocks to bound clock uncertainty
